text: Requiring the field equations G_μν = κ T_μν to reproduce Poisson's equation ∇²Φ = 4πGρ in the weak-field, slow-motion limit fixes the coupling constant to κ = ___.
explanation: In the Newtonian limit the 00-equation gives −∇²h_00 = κ T_00 with T_00 ≈ ρc² and h_00 = −2Φ/c², so ∇²Φ = κρc⁴/2. Matching this to Poisson's equation ∇²Φ = 4πGρ forces κ = 8πG/c⁴. This is exactly the constant appearing in G_μν = 8πG T_μν/c⁴.
